limitations: MVP S3 only: a library (the critic ROLE + provenance tagging). The real critic agent is an injected (input)=>Finding[] seam wired in S4; the module does NOT run S2 verification on the critic output, does NOT call finding_add/review_run_start, and does NOT implement the reopen/escalation loop (all S4). A dedicated lattice-review-completeness lane + a structured provenance field stay FUTURE (§4.4) — MVP carries provenance as a [completeness-critic] desc prefix under a real review lane.
pitfalls: Dual-host adversarial review again caught a test-strength gap the Claude host MISSED (Claude multi-lens Workflow returned overallClean): Codex host-2 flagged that the §4.3 not-a-lane smoke assertion checked the BRACKETED desc tag [completeness-critic] against REVIEW_RUN_LANES instead of the BARE dangerous value completeness-critic — a vacuous check (the bracketed tag is obviously not a lane). Fix: assert !REVIEW_RUN_LANES.includes(completeness-critic) and !includes(lattice-review-completeness). Proactive hardening before review (driven by reading the 33 intents vs the 36-assertion first smoke) closed 8 seam/provenance edge gaps (smoke 36->50), but the bare-vs-bracketed subtlety still needed the cross-provider host. Lesson reinforced from S2: never trust a single host; Codex repeatedly catches the precise-literal test-strength gaps. Run codex exec with </dev/null when backgrounded.
